Before and after

Watch the lights go on

Short clips from recent jobs, from bare plaster to the finished room. Drag the handle on the wall light to compare.

Project 01

Vaulted garden room traced in light

A new garden room in Burford with a bare boarded ceiling. We chased recessed aluminium profiles into both slopes before the plasterer finished, so the LED lines sit flush and follow the roof right down to the eaves.

Recessed LED profileFirst fix before plasterDimmable driverBurford
Before
After
Project 02

Coach lantern out, modern wall light in

A tired outside lantern on a Tetbury new build, swapped for an anthracite up and down light on the existing circuit. Fitted, sealed against the weather and tested in under an hour.

Outdoor lightingIP65 ratedSame dayTetbury
Project 03

Five bell pendants over a new kitchen

The kitchen fitter left us five cable drops in a straight line. We hung and levelled five glass bell pendants at the same height, put them on their own dimmer and handed over a certificate the same afternoon.

Pendant lightingDimmer circuitKitchen refitStow-on-the-Wold
Project 04

Linear LED set into a plastered ceiling

A loft room in Cirencester where the owners wanted light without a single fitting on show. One continuous LED channel now runs around the ceiling, giving soft, even light from wall to wall.

Linear LEDLoft conversionHidden fittingsCirencester

Why choose us

Why the Cotswolds call us

Good electrical work is the bit you never think about again. That is the standard we work to.

NICEIC approved and insured

Every installation meets BS 7671 and is covered by our £5 million public liability insurance, so you are protected from the first visit.

On time, every time

You get an arrival window and we keep to it. If anything changes on the day, you hear it from us first.

Homes and businesses

From one extra socket in a cottage to a full salon fit-out, the same team handles it start to finish.

The same faces every visit

Tom and a small, steady team. No subcontractors you have never met turning up at the door.

Certificated and guaranteed

Notifiable work is registered with building control, and every job carries our 12 month workmanship guarantee.

Local to Cirencester

Based in Cirencester and working across the Cotswolds, so we are close by if you ever need us again.

Meet the owner

Electricians Cotswold

I'm Tom. I served my apprenticeship with a Gloucester contractor, qualified in 2006 and set up Electricians Cotswold in Cirencester in 2009. The business has grown to a small team since then, but I still price every job myself and I'm on site for most of them.

Cotswold homes have their quirks: thick stone walls, listed buildings, old wiring hidden in places nobody expects. We plan around all of it, protect your floors and furniture, and leave the place as tidy as we found it.

Lighting is the part we love most. A well placed pendant or a line of LED in the right spot changes how a room feels, and seeing a customer's face when it all comes on never gets old.

Tom Hartley Owner and electrician, Electricians Cotswold
